mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_POST ( POST_ID, BOARD_TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, CATEGORY, OPEN_SCOPE, PINNED_YN, VIEW_COUNT, WRITER, WRITER_DEPT, CREATED_AT, WRITER_ID, DELETED_YN ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{boardType}, #{title}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{category}, #{openScope}, #{pinnedYn}, 0, #{writer}, #{writerDept}, #{createdAt}, #{writerId}, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD_POST SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATTACH_FILE (FILE_ID, POST_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, STORED_NAME, FILE_SIZE, DOWNLOAD_COUNT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{postId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{fileSize}, 0, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_ID, POST_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, STORED_NAME, FILE_SIZE, DOWNLOAD_COUNT, CREATED_AT FROM ATTACH_FILE WHERE POST_ID IN #{id} ORDER BY POST_ID, FILE_ID

SELECT F.FILE_ID, F.POST_ID, F.ORIGINAL_NAME, F.STORED_NAME, F.FILE_SIZE, F.DOWNLOAD_COUNT, F.CREATED_AT FROM ATTACH_FILE F JOIN BOARD_POST P ON P.POST_ID = F.POST_ID WHERE F.FILE_ID = #{fileId} AND P.DELETED_YN = 'N'

SELECT POST_ID, BOARD_TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, CATEGORY, OPEN_SCOPE, PINNED_YN, VIEW_COUNT, WRITER, WRITER_DEPT, WRITER_ID, DELETED_YN, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY FROM BOARD_POST WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD_POST SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, CATEGORY = #{category}, OPEN_SCOPE = #{openScope}, PINNED_YN = #{pinnedYn}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND DELETED_YN = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ATTACH_FILE WHERE FILE_ID = #{fileId} AND POST_ID = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_COMMENT (COMMENT_ID, POST_ID, CONTENT, WRITER, WRITER_ID, WRITER_DEPT, CREATED_AT, DELETED_YN) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{postId}, #{content}, #{writer}, #{writerId}, #{writerDept}, #{createdAt}, 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT COMMENT_ID, POST_ID, CONTENT, WRITER, WRITER_ID, WRITER_DEPT, CREATED_AT, DELETED_YN FROM BOARD_COMMENT WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND DELETED_YN = 'N' ORDER BY CREATED_AT, COMMENT_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE ATTACH_FILE SET DOWNLOAD_COUNT = DOWNLOAD_COUNT + 1 WHERE FILE_ID = #{fileId}
